# Idea Generation

## Purpose

Generate bounded, testable hypotheses or solution directions from declared context.

## Preconditions

Use an ideation-stage bounded Dispatch with one repository, no network, and available acceptance criteria.

## Inputs

Use the objective and criteria, supplied evidence, context and artifacts, expected outputs, and checks.

## Procedure

Derive multiple distinct candidates, state each assumption and mechanism, define a falsifier or test for each, and avoid ranking beyond supplied evidence.

## Outputs

Return exactly one strict Result listing candidates and uncertainty plus one pending Proposal suggesting candidate artifacts or a root-reviewed next step.

## Checks and Stop Conditions

Stop on duplicate or non-testable ideas, unsupported certainty, scope expansion, or candidates that require forbidden authority.

## Authority Boundaries

Do not make a canonical selection, promote Claims, launch experiments or Dispatches, chain capabilities, mutate Research, or write outside declared paths.
